scriptText:
I. CIRCUIT DROP

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a high-energy J-pop and K-pop crossover music video sequence set inside a rain-slicked brutalist courtyard at dusk, featuring @actor as SAMIRA, @actor as EVAN, @actor as FELIX, @actor as RUBY, and @actor as LEA performing a synchronized chorus choreography during a continuous 360-degree orbiting shot.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Ensure pacing, physical movement, and choreographic transitions are driven entirely by the 120 BPM musical tempo. Maintain unbroken spatial permanence around the five performers arranged in an interlocking pentagon formation. Preserve optical light reflections and wet floor displacement across the continuous camera orbit without geometry morphing. Enforce match-on-action momentum across the unbroken circular tracking movement without cuts.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: 35mm anamorphic digital capture, high shutter speed, crisp motion clarity
Palette: Electric cobalt, neon amber, deep obsidian black, chromatic gunmetal, vivid tangerine accents
Lighting: Overhead circular motorized ring-lights casting volumetric white shafts, saturated magenta rim lighting skimming performer silhouettes, grounded specular bounce from wet ground
Location: Brutalist neo-futuristic amphitheater courtyard beneath an open-air glass prism canopy. Polished rain-slick mirror-tile floor reflecting vertical neon light-strips, flanked by monolithic textured concrete pillars laced with wet moss.
Wardrobe: SAMIRA wearing cropped gunmetal metallic mesh compression top under a translucent iridescent vinyl trench vest, high-waisted black utility cargo trousers with neon-orange nylon straps, chrome link chain necklace, and fingerless leather performance gloves; EVAN wearing an asymmetrical cobalt-blue padded tech-fabric bomber jacket over a distressed white ribbed tank, wide-leg charcoal parachute pants with reflective silver piping, and silver ear-cuffs; FELIX wearing a boxy forest-green satin kimono-blazer over an open-collar sheer black geometric-mesh inner shirt, pleated tailored slate-grey trousers, layered gunmetal pendant chains, and round titanium-rimmed performance glasses; RUBY wearing a cropped hazard-orange PVC moto-jacket over an ultra-fitted black ribbed turtleneck, asymmetrical pleated plaid skirt over matte leather leggings, and studded wristbands; LEA wearing a sculpted terracotta-red bonded leather corset harness over a skin-tight beige mock-neck long-sleeve, flared obsidian-black track pants with snap-button side slits, stacked brass choker, and geometric gold hoop earrings.
Hair/Makeup: Glossy high-definition performance makeup with sweat sheen along temples; Samira with slick wet-look mid-length curls; Evan with textured split bangs; Felix with defined voluminous curls; Ruby with piecey texturized copper spikes; Lea with tight defined curls pulled into a high half-up ponytail.
Audio: Driving 120 BPM electro-pop dance groove, resonant sawtooth synthesizer baseline, syncopated hi-hats, building vocal chorus.
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
MWS, low-angle tilt, facing the five performers locked in a tight pentagon formation at the center of the wet mirrored courtyard. In the foreground center, Samira crouches with her left knee planted and right arm extended low toward the camera. In the midground, Evan stands frame-left with his torso angled outward, while Felix stands frame-right leaning his weight over his back foot. In the background depth plane, Ruby and Lea anchor the formation back-to-back with raised chin profiles. Suspended overhead ring-lights illuminate the performers from directly above, casting vertical light cones and long specular reflections across the glossy floor tiles.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 01] MWS, low-angle, beginning continuous counter-clockwise orbit -> (Driving 120 BPM four-on-the-floor kick drops with sharp synth arpeggio) -> [ACT] Samira snaps her head up directly into the lens -> [DANCE] Samira executes a sudden chest pop and sharp wrist-tut isolation upward while the ensemble synchronizes a unified shoulder-drop -> [SING] Samira (punchy glottal attack) sings: "Now b-break it, 터뜨려!" -> [ACT] Samira pulls both elbows inward, holding eye contact as her weight shifts back.
[CAM 01] Continuing low-angle counter-clockwise orbit sweeping toward Evan -> (Deep sawtooth bassline thrums on beat two with sizzling open hi-hats) -> [ACT] Evan pivots outward to intercept the panning camera -> [DANCE] Evan performs a double-speed housing glide and sharp torso isolation, sweeping his right arm across in a clean horizontal slice -> [SING] Evan (raspy rhythmic bounce) raps: "Run it r-right, 멈추지 마!" -> [ACT] Evan drops his chin with a confident smirk, his right palm snapping down to his hip.
[CAM 01] Smooth orbital drift transitioning from Evan toward Ruby -> (Ascending synth chord progression swells with syncopated snare snaps) -> [ACT] Ruby drops into a low side-lunge between Evan and Lea -> [DANCE] Ruby drives a synchronized locking wrist-roll into an explosive body wave, snapping both arms overhead into a rigid V-frame -> [ACT] Lea and Felix echo the movement in a delayed ripple isolation -> [ACT] Ruby holds her arms locked rigid for a micro-beat, chest expanding in rhythm.
[CAM 01] Sweeping orbital tilt rising slightly to eye-level framing Ruby and Lea -> (Heavy sub-bass pulse thumps on every downbeat) -> [ACT] Ruby glares down the lens, mouth curling into an energetic grin -> [DANCE] Ruby executes a rapid heel-toe swivel and sharp head snap -> [SING] Ruby (bright staccato belting) sings: "F-fire it up, 타올라!" -> [ACT] Ruby steps back smoothly into formation, transferring kinetic momentum toward Lea.
[CAM 01] Orbiting smoothly around to three-quarter profile, reframing Lea in tight medium focus -> (Lush vocoder harmony sweeps through the stereo field behind the drum groove) -> [ACT] Lea whips her curls over her left shoulder, locking eyes with the revolving lens -> [DANCE] Lea channels high-fashion voguing arm lines into a fluid ribcage roll, her fingertips tracing the collar of her harness -> [SING] Lea (breathy resonant glide) sings: "Glow higher, 날아올라—" -> [ACT] Lea drops her gaze downward, fingers trailing across her sternum as she sinks her center of gravity.
[CAM 01] Continuous circular orbit sweeping past Lea toward Felix -> (Staccato synth stabs chop across sixteenth-note hi-hat rolls) -> [ACT] Felix catches the camera arc with an intense gaze behind his glasses -> [DANCE] Felix initiates an intricate finger-tutting sequence transitioning into a dynamic chest wave, his posture snapping upright with sudden kinetic precision -> [ACT] Samira and Evan mirror his arm snap in the blurred background -> [ACT] Felix clenches his left fist at his waistline, shoulders dropping in locked stillness.
[CAM 01] Maintaining orbital sweep at eye-level on Felix -> (Resonant brass synth blare punctuates the downbeat with rising filter sweep) -> [ACT] Felix takes a syncopated cross-step toward the lens -> [DANCE] Felix snaps into a sharp pivot turn, executing an abrupt pop-and-lock isolation at the knees -> [SING] Felix (deep percussive cadence) raps: "C-catch the wave, 거침없이!" -> [ACT] Felix sweeps his right arm downward, freezing his posture as his breath catches.
[CAM 01] Orbit widening slightly as the arc approaches the front line -> (Full drum kit builds with double-time snare roll rushing toward the chorus peak) -> [ACT] All five performers converge into a tight staggered diagonal line -> [DANCE] The entire group hits an explosive five-point ripple wave, undulating from Lea in the back through Felix, Ruby, Evan, to Samira in front -> [ACT] Each performer locks into a crouched power stance as the ripple terminates on Samira.
[CAM 01] Low-angle orbital glide settling toward low frontal vantage -> (Maximal wall-of-sound synth explosion with pounding kick-drum climax) -> [ACT] Samira and Evan thrust their torsos forward in tandem -> [DANCE] Samira and Evan execute a synchronized floor-sweeping slide into an explosive upward jump-turn, snapping their hands outward in unison -> [SING] Samira and Evan (harmonized high-octane shout) sing: "W-we ignite, 끝까지!" -> [ACT] Both land cleanly on the balls of their feet, arms locked outward in tense symmetry.
[CAM 01] Orbit slowing to a deliberate hover, framing the entire quintet in powerful low-angle symmetry -> (Sustained shimmering synth chord hovers over a suspended sub-bass drone) -> [ACT] All five performers simultaneously snap their heads toward the overhead light -> [DANCE] The ensemble executes a unified micro-isolation, dropping their wrists down to their sides in absolute synchronization -> [ACT] Sweat glistens along their temples under the overhead ring-light, chests rising in heavy synchrony as they hold the frozen tableau.
[</BRIEF>]

II. ASTRAL WANDERER

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create an ethereal fantasy music video featuring @actor as ROSA, a mystic wanderer singing to @audio amidst glowing ancient celestial ruins.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Pacing, editing, and rapid cuts must be driven entirely by the 116 BPM tempo of @audio. Maintain strict 180-degree axis discipline during dynamic angle changes, ensure precise lip-sync timing without facial distortion, and preserve consistent bioluminescent lighting physics across all visual states.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: 35mm cinematic fantasy film, anamorphic lens flare.
Palette: Deep twilight indigo, bioluminescent cyan, warm amber accents.
Lighting: High-contrast moonlit rim light with floating ambient embers.
Location: Overgrown celestial sanctuary with shattered crystalline monoliths, ancient stone pillars, and floating mossy ruins.
Wardrobe: ROSA wearing a filigree silver brow circlet, a layered silk tunic under an embroidered velvet traveler robe, and tapered leather greaves.
Audio Reference: @audio driving tempo and vocal performance.
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
MCU, eye-level, camera centered on ROSA standing motionless before a glowing celestial monolith, moonlit mist swirling around her shoulders as she faces forward with resolved eyes.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
00:00 - 00:04 [CAM] MCU, static lockoff on ROSA -> [LIPSYNC] ROSA sings: {이전에 내가 아니야 난 돌아가지 않아} -> [ACT] ROSA maintains steady eye contact forward with resolved posture
00:04 - 00:08 [CAM] WS, slow dolly back -> [ACT] ROSA steps forward across cracked glowing flagstones -> [MUSIC] {공허했었던 그 수많은 밤을 말이야} -> [ACT] glowing atmospheric spores drift across frame-left
00:08 - 00:12 [CAM] MS, low-angle tracking shot -> [LIPSYNC] ROSA sings: {아무도없던 내게 따스히 다가와준} -> [ACT] ROSA extends her right hand toward floating crystal fragments
00:12 - 00:16 [CAM] CU, profile tracking -> [ACT] ROSA softens her expression -> [MUSIC] {그 모든 의미를 난 잊지않아} -> [ACT] warm amber luminescence washes over her face as she turns forward
00:17 - 00:21 [CAM] MCU, dynamic push in -> [LIPSYNC] ROSA sings: {I follow the voices in my heart...} -> [ACT] ROSA places her left palm over her chest with emotional conviction
00:21- 00:25 [CAM] FS, slow crane up -> [ACT] ROSA advances toward the sanctuary overlook -> [MUSIC] {I feel you’re always here... by my side!} -> [ACT] her velvet traveler robe billows in the luminous updraft
00:25 - 00:30 [CAM] CU, orbital arc shifting to wide celestial expanse -> [LIPSYNC] ROSA sings: {I know that you are glo... ri... ous!} -> [ACT] ROSA raises her chin toward the radiant nebula as floating light motes fill the frame
[</BRIEF>]

III. KINETIC SOAP

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a high-energy, vibrant K-pop music video chorus sequence set inside an electric retro-futuristic commercial laundromat, featuring @actor as FIONA and @actor as EVAN executing sharp synchronized choreography and vocal interplay about cyclical emotional baggage and spinning laundry.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Pacing, editing, and rapid transition and cut must be driven entirely by the 120 BPM tempo musiknya. Maintain strict spatial permanence within the central aisle flanked by double-tiered industrial chrome tumblers and the reflective resin floor. Preserve physical inertia during dance spins, ensuring garment straps, chains, and fabric fringe react accurately to angular acceleration. Preserve the 180-degree line of action during dynamic two-shots, keeping Fiona anchored on screen-left and Evan on screen-right.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: Ultra-glossy digital cinema sensor, pristine high-shutter sharpness, subtle horizontal cyan anamorphic flare streaks
Palette: Hyper-saturated electric magenta, vivid turquoise, deep ultraviolet shadows, mirrored chrome highlights
Lighting: Overhead pulsating RGB LED battens synchronized to the tempo, back-lit neon typography through diffused glass, crisp rim light tracing dancer silhouettes
Location: A stylized underground laundromat featuring dual rows of stacked industrial chrome tumblers with glowing circular portholes. Polished teal-and-white checkerboard resin flooring reflects ceiling light arrays, while gentle plumes of mist waft up from recessed floor grates between clear acrylic folding counters.
Wardrobe: Fiona wearing cropped metallic silver puffer vest over sheer black mesh long-sleeve top, high-waisted iridescent lilac parachute cargo trousers with hanging tactical nylon straps, chunky white platform combat boots, and layered chrome chain chokers with mini padlock pendants; Evan wearing oversized cobalt blue denim utility jacket with raw-edge distressed hems over fitted white sleeveless ribbed mock-neck tank, relaxed black coated biker denim trousers with exposed silver zippers, electric-blue high-top leather dance sneakers, and frosted resin ring bands.
Hair/Makeup: Fiona sporting sleek brunette shoulder-length cut with blunt bangs, dewy glass-skin finish, sharp winged graphic eyeliner, and metallic berry-tinted lips; Evan sporting textured dark brown wavy curtain undercut, groomed brows, dewy natural skin, and faint iridescent highlighter along the cheekbones.
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
MS, eye-level, centered down the gleaming laundromat aisle, framing Fiona on frame-left and Evan on frame-right standing side-by-side in parallel ready stances. Both performers hold neutral athletic postures, arms slightly angled at their sides with fingers loosely hooked into their cargo pockets, eyes fixed forward on the camera lens as steam drifts across the reflective floor in the foreground beneath overhead magenta and cyan tubes.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 01] MS, eye-level, static center -> [SING] Fiona sings (staccato punch with glottal stop): "Roun' and roun', spi-i-in it out, 다 돌아!" -> [DANCE] Fiona and Evan simultaneously snap their heads toward the lens, chest-popping forward on the downbeat before whipping their right arms across their torsos -> [ACT] Evan slides his right boot back along the glossy floor.
[CAM 02] MCU, low-angle on Fiona -> [SING] Fiona sings (melismatic slide with breathy dynamic accent): "Wa-a-ash away the dirt, ri'nse the hurt, 깨끗이!" -> [DANCE] Fiona drops low into a wide stance, executing an isolative torso roll while flicking both hands upward near her collarbones -> [CAM 03] CU, Dutch angle on Evan -> [SING] Evan raps (syncopated rhythmic bounce with staccato finish): "Tumble down, dry it out, don't look back, 멈춰!" -> [DANCE] Evan locks his elbows, slicing his forearms horizontally in front of his chest before pivoting ninety degrees screen-left -> [ACT] Evan flashes a sharp smirk toward the ceiling lights.
[CAM 04] High-angle bird's-eye tracking down the aisle -> (... pulsating 120 BPM synth bass bounce and syncopated snare rolls ...) -> [DANCE] Fiona and Evan move in parallel diagonal patterns, crossing footwork in rapid double-time kick-ball-changes across the checkerboard tiles -> [ACT] Both performers pivot outward toward the rows of glowing machines.
[CAM 05] Whip-pan right to side profile of Evan -> [SING] Evan raps (rapid staccato punch): "Cycles runnin' cold, no fold, 전부 버려!" -> [DANCE] Evan hits a sharp shoulder pop, pulling both fists back to his ribcage -> [CAM 06] Low-angle push-in on Fiona center -> [SING] Fiona sings (piercing head-voice extension): "Ooh, le' it bu-u-urn through the spi'n!" -> [DANCE] Fiona plant-spins on her left heel, swinging her iridescent cargo straps wide as she drops into a centered knee-bend -> [ACT] Fiona locks her gaze directly down into the lens.
[CAM 07] ECU on spinning circular dryer glass -> [SING] Fiona sings (off-screen rhythmic vocal ad-lib): "Dri-i-p, dra-a-p, out!" -> [ACT] Evan's hand slams flat against the exterior chrome frame in frame-right -> [DANCE] Evan uses the tumbler frame to lever a sharp ninety-degree body turn toward the aisle -> [ACT] Evan's fingertips slide smoothly off the polished metal surface.
[CAM 08] MWS, dynamic tracking two-shot -> [SING] Evan raps (resonant chest tone): "So-o-oapy suds risin' up, keep it cl-e-ean, 세탁해!" -> [DANCE] Evan steps across frame-center, executing three rapid tutting hand locks with geometric precision -> [DANCE] Fiona mirrors the final lock from frame-left, extending both palms outward toward Evan -> [ACT] Fiona tilts her chin up, shifting weight to her back foot.
[CAM 09] Low tracking shot on footwork -> (... surging four-on-the-floor kick pattern ...) -> [DANCE] Fiona and Evan sync their platform boots in sharp synchronized heel-toe ground glides across the damp reflective floor -> [CAM 10] MCU snap-zoom on Fiona -> [SING] Fiona sings (vowel extension with micro-pause): "Tu-u-urn the dial, ma-a-ake it ri'ght!" -> [DANCE] Fiona pulls both elbows inward, rolling her head to the left shoulder -> [ACT] Fiona's blunt bangs brush across her brow before settling.
[CAM 11] OTS behind Evan toward Fiona -> [SING] Fiona sings (aggressive staccato belt): "Shake it o-o-ff, let it go, 다 끝났어!" -> [DANCE] Fiona points directly at Evan's chest, bouncing her shoulders twice in rhythm -> [CAM 12] OTS behind Fiona toward Evan -> [SING] Evan raps (breathy glottal snap): "No sta-a-ains on my che'st, done wi'th the me'ss!" -> [DANCE] Evan sweeps his jacket lapels open and closed with a crisp wrist snap -> [ACT] Evan holds his posture firm, unblinking.
[CAM 13] Low-angle wide tracking forward between the dancers -> [SING] Fiona and Evan sing together (harmonized staccato unison): "Spi-i-in, wa-a-ash, cle-e-an, 끝!" -> [DANCE] Both dancers perform a synchronized double-spin inward, locking simultaneously into a grounded power-lunge side-by-side -> [CAM 14] Dutch tilt MCU on dual profile -> [ACT] Fiona and Evan face opposite directions back-to-back -> [DANCE] Both throw their outer arms skyward in an accented lock on the downbeat -> [ACT] Their chests heave together in recovery.
[CAM 15] WS, rapid crane pullback through drifting steam -> (... sustained resonant synth chord decay ...) -> [DANCE] Fiona and Evan hold their frozen back-to-back silhouette pose against the glowing magenta portholes -> [ACT] Floating ceiling mist drifts slowly across their motionless forms as the LED battens dim down to low ultraviolet glow.
[</BRIEF>]

IV. DUMPLING THRONE

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a high-energy fantasy K-pop music video driven by @audio featuring @actor as ROSA and @actor as MARCUS locked in a stylized, in-media-res contest for the final dumpling in a floating neon-jade temple.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Pacing and editing must be driven entirely by the tempo of @audio. Maintain strict 180-degree axis discipline between ROSA screen-left and MARCUS screen-right. Prioritize stable spatial tracking of the floating steamer pedestal and character hand props across all transitions.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: 35mm anamorphic, glossy hyper-stylized K-pop fantasy
Palette: Electric magenta, jade green, imperial gold, deep midnight blue
Lighting: Sharp volumetric stage beams, rim backlighting, ambient bioluminescent ground fog
Location: Floating celestial pavilion, lacquered vermilion pillars, suspended translucent lotus lanterns, polished obsidian floor
Wardrobe (ROSA): Cropped metallic-gold tech jacket, black mesh undershirt, pleated combat skirt, illuminated hairpin accessories
Wardrobe (MARCUS): Structured midnight-blue utility coat, crimson silk sleeveless base, fitted tactical trousers, studded wrist wraps
Audio: Non-Diegetic Sound only. Music and audio sync to @audio. No Foley/SFX.
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
Low-angle wide shot on the temple platform, ROSA standing alert frame-left with extended metallic chopsticks, MARCUS crouched opposite in frame-right, facing a glowing bamboo steamer levitating between them under converging white spotlights.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[00:00 - 00:02] [CAM] Low-angle WS lockoff on the dais -> [ACT] Steam pours from the levitating basket as ROSA and MARCUS simultaneously shift weight into a forward sprint -> [MUSIC] (Heavy rhythmic synth pulse) -> [ACT] Both freeze mid-stride in sharp dynamic choreographic poses.
[00:02 - 00:04] [CAM] MCU tracking shot tilting up on MARCUS -> [LIPSYNC] MARCUS sings {The stage is set now} -> [ACT] MARCUS sweeps his right arm overhead, sending a gust of wind across the dais.
[00:04 - 00:07] [CAM] Profile MS tracking MARCUS circling right-to-left -> [LIPSYNC] MARCUS sings {Let the battle begin for the last prize} -> [ACT] MARCUS snaps his fingers, summoning floating jade shields around the steamer.
[00:07 - 00:09] [CAM] Rapid zoom-in to ECU of the steaming dumpling hovering in mid-air -> [ACT] Chopsticks enter frame-left and frame-right, clashing above the lid -> [MUSIC] (Snare-driven syncopated transition beat) -> [ACT] Shockwave pushes both pairs of chopsticks back.
[00:09 - 00:11] [CAM] MCU Dutch angle tracking ROSA screen-left -> [LIPSYNC] ROSA sings {김이 모락모락 피어나는 대나무 속} -> [ACT] ROSA slides smoothly on the polished obsidian floor, spinning her metallic chopsticks between her fingers.
[00:11 - 00:13] [CAM] ECU on ROSA's focused gaze, amber eyes catching magenta rim light -> [LIPSYNC] ROSA sings {내 눈빛은 흔들림 없어} -> [ACT] ROSA narrows her eyes and tilts her chin upward with an icy smirk.
[00:13 - 00:15] [CAM] Dynamic tracking OTS over MARCUS toward ROSA -> [LIPSYNC] ROSA sings {완벽한 젓가락질} -> [ACT] ROSA executes a crisp geometric arm wave, tracing glowing gold light trails in the air.
[00:15 - 00:17] [CAM] MS front-facing tracking shot pushing into ROSA -> [LIPSYNC] ROSA sings {한 번이면 너는} -> [ACT] ROSA leaps forward off a levitating lotus lantern, descending toward center frame.
[00:17 - 00:18] [CAM] Fast whip pan from ROSA to Marcus flinching frame-right -> [LIPSYNC] ROSA sings {그냥 구경꾼!} -> [ACT] MARCUS raises his forearm to block a flash of golden sparks.
[00:18 - 00:20] [CAM] Low-angle CU tracking ROSA mid-air -> [LIPSYNC] ROSA sings {Last one is mine!} -> [ACT] ROSA dives diagonally downward, extending her chopsticks directly toward the pedestal.
[00:20 - 00:22] [CAM] Two-shot tracking ROSA and MARCUS converging at center -> [LIPSYNC] ROSA sings {I want it all, don't touch!} -> [ACT] MARCUS intercepts her grip with his wrist guard, sparks flying between them.
[00:22 - 00:24] [CAM] Rapid 360-degree orbit around the locked duelists -> [LIPSYNC] ROSA sings {My plate, this is my war!} -> [ACT] The bamboo lid shatters upward, revealing the glowing golden dumpling levitating into open air.
[00:24 - 00:28] [CAM] Wide crane shot rising vertically above the dais as floating platforms elevate into a massive arena -> [LIPSYNC] MARCUS sings {The final judgment has been made, and the winner takes it all.} -> [ACT] Both leap skyward toward the ascendant dumpling as blinding volumetric stage beams erupt beneath them into an escalating cliffhanger clash.
[</BRIEF>]

V. ELECTRIC MIST

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a cinematic, emotionally charged J-pop music video chorus sequence set inside a rain-swept modernist greenhouse conservatory, featuring @actor as EVAN and @actor as ROSA executing an unbroken orbiting partner choreography that captures the friction, kinetic intimacy, and longing of their parallel, divergent lives.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Pacing, rhythmic momentum, and kinetic choreography transitions must be driven entirely by the 120 BPM musical tempo. Maintain an unbroken 360-degree orbital camera trajectory centered strictly on the shared physical pivot axis between Evan and Rosa. Preserve spatial permanence within the circular clearing of the wet conservatory floor, ensuring reflective puddle coordinates remain fixed. Enforce tactile hand-to-wardrobe contact persistence so garment grips and lapel pulls do not spontaneously detach between continuous beats. Maintain physical inertia on loose garments, yellow hair strands, and falling rain mist without visual warping, morphing, or spatial resets.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: 35mm digital anamorphic, hyper-crisp motion shutter, subtle anamorphic streak flares, fine textural grain
Palette: Dual-world split contrast of saturated electric cyan, deep nocturnal indigo, magenta backlight accents, and shimmering chrome highlights
Lighting: Directional overhead cyan flood through rain-streaked geometric glass ceiling panels, punctuated by warm magenta rim kickers and rhythmic strobe pulses synced to the musical tempo
Location: A cavernous brutalist glasshouse conservatory filled with towering shadowed ferns and sprawling monstera plants. Broken overhead skylights allow a gentle mist to drift down onto the dark, water-sheened concrete floor that mirrors every movement and light source. Structural steel framework arches dramatically overhead into the dark night sky.
Wardrobe: Evan wearing an oversized slate-grey deconstructed structural blazer with raw-edge lapels over a fitted silver metallic mesh tank, paired with high-waisted pleated charcoal wide-leg trousers, a draped industrial chrome ball-chain necklace, and matte black combat boots; Rosa wearing a cropped asymmetrical plum-purple vinyl moto jacket with silver exposed zippers over a distressed ivory rib-knit bandeau, matched with a layered cobalt denim micro-cargo skirt featuring trailing utility straps, a double-tiered silver link choker, and chunky platform lug-sole boots
Hair/Makeup: Evan styled with natural textured wavy black hair swept off his forehead with subtle damp sheen, natural radiant skin with defined jawline contouring; Rosa styled with a tousled wavy chin-length dark bob featuring vivid electric-yellow underlayer streaks framing her face, dewy skin with fine iridescent glitter dusted across high cheekbones, and stained glossy berry lips
Audio: Driving 120 BPM four-on-the-floor electro-pop groove, syncopated sixteenth-note hi-hats, warm analog synth bassline arpeggiating upward, and crystalline atmospheric vocal pads
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
MCU two-shot, eye-level, capturing Evan and Rosa standing chest-to-chest in tight physical proximity at frame-center, Rosa facing screen-left with her right hand gripping the notched lapel of Evan's structured blazer, while Evan faces screen-right with his left hand cupping the crest of Rosa's jacketed shoulder, their foreheads angled mere inches apart in breathless stillness against the diffuse cyan light streaming through the rain-streaked glass panels behind them.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 01] MCU two-shot, initiating a fluid clockwise orbital track around the performers -> (120 BPM chorus drops with a punchy kick and swelling synth arpeggio) -> [DANCE] Evan executes a sharp chest-pop isolation on the downbeat while Rosa mirrors with an angular head snap and shoulder drop -> [ACT] Rosa's knuckles tighten into the fabric of Evan's lapel -> [SING] Rosa sings with percussive breathy staccato: "갈-라진^ dawn, we run a-way!" -> [ACT] Evan's left thumb slides along Rosa's shoulder seam as his eyes lock onto hers.
[CAM 01] continuing orbital arc around Rosa's back toward Evan's profile -> (Heavy analog synth bassline engages with syncopated rhythmic drive) -> [ACT] Evan draws Rosa closer by pulling gently on her lapel -> [DANCE] Evan leads a synchronized 180-degree pivot turn on the balls of their feet, their hips rotating in locked unison -> [SING] Evan sings with resonant chest resonance and a glottal bite: "두 개의 길- we can't un-break!" -> [ACT] Rosa tilts her chin upward, her breath visible in the cool greenhouse air.
[CAM 01] low-angle orbital glide continuing around their interlocking silhouettes -> (Driving sixteenth-note hi-hat pattern accelerates toward a syncopated snare fill) -> [DANCE] Both dancers break into rapid geometric wrist-lock tutting between their torsos, tracing sharp angular frames across each other's chest -> [ACT] Evan's knuckles lightly graze Rosa's chrome choker -> [ACT] Rosa whips her head to the side, her yellow-streaked hair brushing Evan's collarbone as she rebounds off the rhythmic pulse.
